subject.title: [Feature]: replace plugin approval caller IDs with authenticated context

question: Which verified caller-provenance fields and compatibility window should become the supported public plugin approval contract?
rationale: Source and maintainer review establish that request-supplied identity is unacceptable, but maintainers must approve the permanent external SDK shape, authentication-locality semantics, and removal schedule.

options.title: Verified context plus deprecation
options.body: Add a closed core-populated context, ignore legacy routing identity for authorization and delivery, migrate bundled plugins, and retain deprecated fields only for a documented transition window.

options.title: Keep provenance core-only
options.body: Use authenticated caller provenance internally and do not expose caller-specific routing context through the external plugin approval API.

options.title: Remove legacy fields immediately
options.body: Delete agentId and sessionKey from approval requests in the first change and require external plugins to update without a transition period.

recommendation.title: Verified context plus deprecation
recommendation.body: Add a closed core-populated context, ignore legacy routing identity for authorization and delivery, migrate bundled plugins, and retain deprecated fields only for a documented transition window.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current surface, defined the trust-boundary requirement in review, opened the follow-up, and is its current assignee.
